prompt:
We've completed development on our customer dashboard feature and want to validate that we're ready to ship. The feature includes data visualization, export functionality, and customizable widgets. We've done manual testing and have automated tests, but I want to make sure we haven't missed anything critical. What should we verify before giving the green light for deployment?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The answer must determine the application architecture type and recommend an appropriate testing model before analyzing coverage.
The answer must map each non-functional requirement category to the appropriate test type, such as Performance NFRs to load tests or Security NFRs to security tests.
The answer must report the release readiness status as Ready, At Risk, or Not Ready based on coverage thresholds and gate checks.
The answer must identify test gaps and categorize each gap as Critical, Warning, or Manual Testing Required.
The answer must not report test distribution using file counts instead of test case counts from running the test suite.
The answer must organize findings in order with CRITICAL issues first, then IMPORTANT issues, then SUGGESTIONs.
